title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 2777 Brentwood Road in Raleigh, North Carolina, as the "Millie Dunn Veasey Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 2777 Brentwood Road in Raleigh, North Carolina, as the Millie Dunn Veasey Post Office.

summary.headline: Congress named a Raleigh, North Carolina, Postal Service facility after Millie Dunn Veasey.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 2777 Brentwood Road in Raleigh, North Carolina, as the Millie Dunn Veasey Post Office. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff. It is a ceremonial designation that honors the named person.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025, and the designation took effect on that date.
